001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * FreeStyle Libre 3 CGM session join.
009 */
010@HistoryLogProps(
011    opCode = 477,
012    displayName = "CGM Join Session (FSL3)",
013    internalName = "LID_CGM_JOIN_SESSION_FSL3"
014)
015public class CgmJoinSessionFsl3HistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
016
017    private long sessionStartTime;
018    private long sessionJoinTime;
019    private int sessionDuration;
020    private int sessionJoinReason;
021    private long sessionDurationSecs;
022
023    public CgmJoinSessionFsl3HistoryLog() {}
024    public CgmJoinSessionFsl3HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
025        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
026    }
027
028    public CgmJoinSessionFsl3HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long sessionStartTime, long sessionJoinTime, int sessionDuration, int sessionJoinReason, long sessionDurationSecs) {
029        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
030        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, sessionStartTime, sessionJoinTime, sessionDuration, sessionJoinReason, sessionDurationSecs);
031        parse(cargo);
032    }
033
034    public int typeId() {
035        return 477;
036    }
037
038    /**
039     * <table border="1">
040     * <caption>Parsed fields for CgmJoinSessionFsl3HistoryLog:</caption>
041     * <tr><td><code>sessionStartTime</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
042     * <tr><td><code>sessionJoinTime</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
043     * <tr><td><code>sessionDuration</code></td><td><code>raw[18] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
044     * <tr><td><code>sessionJoinReason</code></td><td><code>raw[19] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
045     * <tr><td><code>sessionDurationSecs</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
046     * </table>
047     */
048    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
049        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
050        this.cargo = raw;
051        parseBase(raw);
052        this.sessionStartTime = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
053        this.sessionJoinTime = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
054        this.sessionDuration = raw[18] & 0xFF;
055        this.sessionJoinReason = raw[19] & 0xFF;
056        this.sessionDurationSecs = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
057    }
058
059    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
060        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
061    }
062
063    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long sessionStartTime, long sessionJoinTime, int sessionDuration, int sessionJoinReason, long sessionDurationSecs) {
064        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
065            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(477, 0),
066            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
067            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
068            Bytes.toUint32(sessionStartTime),
069            Bytes.toUint32(sessionJoinTime),
070            new byte[]{(byte) sessionDuration},
071            new byte[]{(byte) sessionJoinReason},
072            new byte[]{0, 0},
073            Bytes.toUint32(sessionDurationSecs)));
074    }
075
076    /**
077     * @return session start time, in seconds since the Tandem epoch
078     */
079    public long getSessionStartTime() {
080        return sessionStartTime;
081    }
082    /**
083     * @return session join time, in seconds since the Tandem epoch
084     */
085    public long getSessionJoinTime() {
086        return sessionJoinTime;
087    }
088    /**
089     * @return session duration, in days
090     */
091    public int getSessionDuration() {
092        return sessionDuration;
093    }
094    /**
095     * @return reason the session was joined (values not documented by Tandem)
096     */
097    public int getSessionJoinReason() {
098        return sessionJoinReason;
099    }
100    /**
101     * @return session duration, in seconds
102     */
103    public long getSessionDurationSecs() {
104        return sessionDurationSecs;
105    }
106}
